title: The day's type sets the shape
text: Story day: one spine. Issue day: a briefing (the damage, each voice's best beat, the takeaways, the threat). Panel: every guest, thinned. Advice day: broadcast order with one move, experts trimmed word by word, the key tip repeated on purpose (M-4 does not apply), the hook is the most counter-intuitive tip, the end is the human cost.

source.heading: Candidates from the overnight study (2026-11-23, none confirmed)
